# hiok_key_vault_item (Resource)

A secret, key or certificate in a key vault. Changing `value` stores a new version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hiok_key_vault" "app" { name = "app-secrets" }

resource "hiok_key_vault_item" "b2_appkey" {
  vault_id = hiok_key_vault.app.id
  name     = "b2-appkey"
  value    = var.b2_appkey # never commit the value itself
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `vault_id` (String) The key vault's id.

### Optional

- `content_type` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `expires_on` (String) RFC 3339 expiry.
- `generate` (Boolean) Generate the value (keys and random secrets) instead of supplying one.
- `item_type` (String) secret (default), key or certificate.
- `not_before` (String) RFC 3339 time before which the item is unusable.
- `size` (Number) Key size or secret length when generating.
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret's value. Never read back into state after creation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `version` (String) Current version.
